limitations: Agent-authored source-anchored questions; no independent human validation.
Positive judgments are incomplete; scores measure known reference documents, not exhaustive relevance.
Small current-source corpus; no claim of generalization.
Warm latency excludes initial loading; cold-start measurements shown separately.
Threshold fixed at 0.8 in advance; test set not used for tuning.
Document-level reference metrics do not measure answer-bearing chunk selection or factual correctness of generation.

environment.conditions: Running Docker API; no duplicate ML evaluation process or concurrent indexing. Ordinary desktop background work and brief unit checks may affect timings. Server-stage timing excludes HTTP transit and queue waiting.

supersedes.reason: Earlier N+1 extraction included related-article previews; those measurements are obsolete.
